name: 183. Claude Haiku 5.5 bills prompts over 100k tokens at its long-context rates (haiku-100k-pricing-tier)
description: Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length: once a prompt exceeds 100,000 tokens (input plus cache reads and writes), every token category in that request bills at the higher rate (input $0.50, output $2.50, 5m cache write $0.625, 1h cache write $1, cache read $0.05 per MTok vs $0.10 / $0.50 / $0.125 / $0.20 / $0.01 at or under 100k; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing). The datasheet publishes these as *_above_100k_tokens keys, which the cost engine previously dropped, so a long Haiku 5.5 prompt billed at the base rate (one fifth of the real cost). Each case sends a chat completion through anthropic, polls GET /api/logs/{x-request-id}, and asserts cost_breakdown.total_cost equals the cost derived from the response usage at the tier's published rates. The under-100k case pins the base tier; the over-100k case is red before the fix (logged cost is one fifth of expected).
